motion.interactions: Snappy, instantaneous. Micro-interactions on Add-to-Cart (slight scale bounce).
motion.toast: Slide in from bottom-right, red border for alerts, green border for success. Fast auto-dismiss.

images.description: Blurred supermarket aisle, gives retail context.
Barcode scanner close up for empty cart or scan-to-start screen.
Example of bold, blocky retail signage.

media.placeholders: DO NOT USE placeholders. Use provided images or lucide icons.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='checkout-button')

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Red (primary) should be used aggressively for key actions.
Implement the POS split layout using Flexbox, ensuring the right cart panel takes full height (h-screen) and doesn't scroll with the left product panel.
Use JetBrains Mono for prices, quantities, and receipt texts.
Override all Shadcn UI default border-radius to 0px (rounded-none).
Ensure the barcode scanning flow works (simulate if no actual camera, but provide the UI overlay for it).
Dashboard tables must be dense and look like an Excel sheet / data grid.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as per the testing rules.
Avoid generic 'Inter' fonts for headings - strictly use Cabinet Grotesk (from Google Fonts or bunny fonts).
